meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: Claude 会按代码结构而不是文字内容来搜代码和改代码:找出所有某种形状的函数、调用、类或导入,把 console.log 批量换成 logger.info,或运行 YAML 规则。改写默认先给预览,确认后才动文件。
howto.when: 当你要找的是代码的语法形状(如某种调用、类、导入的写法),或需要做 codemod、跑 YAML 规则时接管;单纯找字符串、注释或文件名会改用 rg。

say.text: 帮我找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按语法结构搜索并列出匹配位置

say.text: 把项目里所有 console.log 改成 logger.info,先给预览
say.note: 默认 dry-run,不直接改文件

say.text: 扫一遍仓库里的 YAML 规则并报告违规
say.note: 运行 sg scan 输出违规位置

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax shape, not text: find every function, call, class or import by pattern, rewrite console.log to logger.info, or run YAML rules in 25 languages. Rewrites preview first before changing files.
howto.when_en: Use when the target is a syntax shape (a call, class or import written a certain way), a codemod, or a YAML rule; for plain strings, comments or filenames it uses rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Searches by AST structure and lists matches

say_en.text: Rewrite all console.log calls to logger.info, show a preview first
say_en.note: Dry-run by default; files change only with --apply

say_en.text: Scan the repo with our YAML rules and report violations
say_en.note: Runs sg scan and surfaces violations
